_README: Holiday calendar (IST). The system uses the calendar named in config.json's holidays.default_calendar_id. A project can override via its holiday_calendar_id field. Per FR §B.7.3, a holiday WEEK (a week containing any of these dates) auto-skips weekly aggregation. Keys starting with '_' are documentation only — the loader ignores them.
_help_calendars: Add or remove calendar entries under 'calendars'. The key (e.g. 'default', 'bengaluru', 'seoul') is referenced by config.json holidays.default_calendar_id or per-project holiday_calendar_id. Each calendar has a description and a holidays list of {date: YYYY-MM-DD, name: ...} objects. Replace the holidays below with your actual company calendar; add additional calendars per region/team if needed.

default.description: India national holidays + corporate holidays for 2026 (FILL ME IN)

_example_regional_calendar._help: Example of an optional regional calendar. To enable, rename the key (drop the leading underscore) and reference it from a project's holiday_calendar_id in config.json.
